clue.text: Entice after a time trial

indicators.note: after tells us the enticing word is placed behind the two short pieces that follow it in the clue

blocks.note: taken as written
T is the standard abbreviation for time
to entice is to lure or tempt

explanation.surface: Someone is lured into taking part after timing themselves in a trial run.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial and an attempt are both a try or effort at doing something, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Lack of interest for a course on Yiddish to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with means only the opening letter of the language name is used

blocks.note: taken as written
a path is a route or course
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A student shows little enthusiasm for an introductory Yiddish class.
explanation.definitionFit: Apathy is indifference, a want of enthusiasm or concern, the same as a lack of interest.

clue.text: Bit of a pain to get disguised to secure victory

indicators.note: something disguised has its appearance altered, so the letters are rearranged
to secure means to hold fast, so the rearranged letters grip the victory word inside

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
a win is a victory

explanation.surface: A short pang has to be hidden if the player is to clinch the win.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinge is a sudden brief sharp pain, a small portion of pain.

clue.text: Parmesan company briefly manufactured Italian cream cheese

indicators.note: manufactured means made up from raw material, so the letters are reworked

blocks.note: taken as written
CO is the short form of company

explanation.surface: A firm producing one Italian cheese also makes another.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascarpone is a soft, rich Italian cheese made from cream, used in tiramisu.

clue.text: Just over 33% in position for bronze

blocks.note: first meaning: one part in three is 33.3 recurring percent
second meaning: the place in a race that earns the bronze medal

explanation.walkthrough: The percentage reads like a statistic, but it is simply the fraction one part of three.
explanation.definitionFit: One of three equal parts is just above a third of a hundred; finishing in the medal place after gold and silver wins bronze.

clue.text: Just out of bed?

blocks.note: first meaning: honest, morally correct
second meaning: standing vertically rather than lying down

explanation.walkthrough: The question reads as 'only just got up?', but Just is a separate adjective meaning honourable.
explanation.definitionFit: An upright person is honest and principled; someone upright is also standing erect rather than lying in bed.

clue.text: A French tunnel is blocked by the German sabotage

indicators.note: a passage blocked by something has that thing lodged inside it

blocks.note: un is French for a
a mine is an underground tunnel
der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: German saboteurs obstruct a Channel tunnel on the French side.
explanation.definitionFit: To undermine is to weaken something secretly from beneath, the same as to sabotage it.

clue.text: Ridicule European craze

blocks.note: to rag someone is to tease them
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: Someone mocks a fad that is sweeping Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The rage is a passing fashion, as in 'all the rage', so it means a craze.

clue.text: Appreciative of a rug left around

indicators.note: around suggests turning things about, so the letters are moved into another order

blocks.note: the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: Someone is thankful for a carpet that was left lying about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like the abbreviation L, but all four letters are part of the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Being grateful means feeling thanks for something, i.e. appreciating it.

clue.text: Gallery director goes around excessively adorned with body art

indicators.note: goes around means the gallery and director pieces encircle the next word

blocks.note: the Tate is the London art gallery
D is the abbreviation for director
too means excessively

explanation.surface: The head of an art gallery shows off far too much ink.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tattooed has permanent designs inked into their skin, which is body art.

clue.text: Alternative name for a rotated sail

indicators.note: something rotated is turned round, so the word is read from its other end

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written, then turned round

explanation.surface: A sailor looks for a different word for a sail that has been turned.
explanation.definitionFit: An alias is an assumed or second name someone goes by, i.e. another name.

clue.text: Outraged by popular insult to northern worker

blocks.note: something popular is in fashion
a dig is a snide remark
N is the abbreviation for northern
the worker ant is the crosswording worker

explanation.surface: Someone is offended by a widely shared slight aimed at a labourer from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Indignant means angry at perceived unfairness, a close synonym of outraged.

clue.text: Helpless drunk also needs a drink

blocks.note: high means intoxicated
and means also, in addition
someone dry is thirsty

explanation.surface: A paralytic drinker still wants another round.
explanation.definitionFit: Left high and dry is an idiom for being stranded without help, like a boat beached by the tide.

clue.text: Written communication from troublesome Moscow

indicators.note: from here means the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A worrying letter has arrived from the Russian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A memo is a short note or memorandum circulated in writing, typically within an office.

clue.text: Image appears again in reduced form on diagram

blocks.note: the clipped everyday form of the word being defined, so the answer reappears in shortened form
a graph is a diagram plotting data

explanation.surface: A picture is reproduced at smaller size on a chart.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay refers back to the definition: the image word, cut short, is the first half of itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph is a picture taken with a camera, i.e. an image.

clue.text: Local building open to all

blocks.note: first meaning: a British name for the neighbourhood pub
second meaning: read literally, a house the general public may enter

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'the local' is the pub nearest your home; the second half is the formal name read word by word.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub is formally licensed as a public house, a place anyone may come in to drink.

clue.text: Less than perfect Lib Dems he corrupted

indicators.note: corrupted means spoiled or altered, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A man has led the Liberal Democrats, a British political party, astray and they are now flawed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something blemished has a mark or flaw, so it falls short of perfection.

clue.text: Expelled bishop disappeared without vestments, originally

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the clothing word
without means lacking, so that letter is removed

blocks.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
vanished means disappeared
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A defrocked bishop vanished, leaving his robes behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To be banished is to be sent away or exiled, which is being expelled.

clue.text: Debris from ship crew abandoned a long time after last of attack

indicators.note: abandoned can mean wild and unrestrained, so the letters are thrown about
last of means only the final letter of the following word is used
after places the long-time piece behind the single letter that follows

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
the final letter of the word
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: Sailors left a ship long ago after it was attacked, leaving debris behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Wreckage is the broken remains of something destroyed, such as a sunken vessel.

clue.text: Order called English troops to get into craft

indicators.note: getting into something means going inside it, so these pieces sit within the craft

blocks.note: art is a skill or craft
rang means telephoned, called
E is the abbreviation for English
troops are soldiers or men

explanation.surface: An instruction summons English soldiers to board a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrangement is the way things are ordered or set out, so order is a synonym.

clue.text: Vehicle bachelor regularly loans can be used for dating

indicators.note: regularly means taking letters at even intervals, here every second one

blocks.note: a car is a vehicle
B is the abbreviation for bachelor
the second and fourth letters

explanation.surface: A single man lends his car to help his love life.
explanation.walkthrough: Dating sounds romantic, but it means fixing the age of ancient remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiocarbon dating measures the decay of the isotope carbon-14 to find the age of organic material.

clue.text: Remove part of raised concrete ledge

indicators.note: part of means the letters are a section of the words that follow
in a down entry, raised means read from bottom to top, so the letters run the other way

blocks.note: the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A builder takes away a section of an elevated concrete shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: To delete is to erase or strike out, so it means to remove.

clue.text: Urge to change course after losing two leaders

indicators.note: losing two leaders means the first pair of letters is dropped from the front

blocks.note: to switch is to change direction

explanation.surface: Someone feels the impulse to alter direction after two people in charge leave.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a restless desire or craving, so it works as a noun for an urge.

clue.text: Quick payment provides enough for basic needs

blocks.note: quick in the old sense means alive, as in 'the quick and the dead'
a wage is pay for work

explanation.surface: A fast pay packet covers the essentials.
explanation.walkthrough: Quick keeps its archaic meaning of alive here, not fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A living wage is pay high enough to cover the necessities of life, a term used in wage campaigns.

clue.text: Produce children

blocks.note: first meaning: to put out or release, as a publication
second meaning: offspring

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it sounds like having a family; the words are two separate senses.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue is to bring out or produce something; issue is also a legal word for a person's offspring.

clue.text: Heat up raw meat starter

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is read from bottom to top
starter means the opening letter of the food word

blocks.note: taken as written, then turned round
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A cook is told to heat up uncooked meat for the first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heat up' looks like the definition, but up belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To warm something is to heat it gently, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Unfortunately, EEC has had problems

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things went wrong, so the letters come out in a muddled order

blocks.note: the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: The European Economic Community, Britain's former trading bloc, has run into difficulties.
explanation.definitionFit: Headaches is common slang for troubles or nuisances, a figurative sense of the pain.

clue.text: Lake District town team going for a gentle walk

indicators.note: going here means leaving, so that part of the town's name departs

blocks.note: a town at the head of Windermere in England's Lake District
a side is a sports team

explanation.surface: A sports side from a Cumbrian town heads out for a stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: To amble is to walk at a slow, leisurely pace, and the noun names such a stroll.

clue.text: Horror surrounding chronic fatigue syndrome is imagined

indicators.note: surrounding means the horror word wraps around the illness

blocks.note: dread is great fear
ME, myalgic encephalomyelitis, is the condition also called chronic fatigue syndrome

explanation.surface: The fear around a long-term illness is said to be all in the mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamed means pictured in the mind or fancied, the same sense as imagined.

clue.text: At first, extra nutrients helped terrible acne to improve

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of each word is taken
terrible suggests something in a bad way, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: initials of these three words
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Diet supplements were initially used to clear up bad spots.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to make it better or increase its quality, a synonym of improve.
